skill.name: xhs-creator-content-research
skill.description: Research Xiaohongshu creator posts, recent publishing activity, content styles, and comparison accounts using SocialDataX CLI or available MCP tools.
skill.summary: Retrieve creator post evidence and prepare content research summaries for Xiaohongshu accounts.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: All 39 static alerts are false positives involving Markdown, service documentation, credential variable names, account identifiers, and readable multilingual text. The instructions separately introduce a supply chain risk by running an unpinned npm package with automatic installation approval. No evidence found of prompt injection, embedded credentials, or intentional exfiltration; the external package implementation was not included for verification.

remediation.issue: The direct CLI examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y without a pinned, reviewed dependency.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify package provenance and integrity, and obtain approval before first execution with access to SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned External Package Execution
semantic_findings.description: Both CLI examples run npx -y socialdatax-skills@latest, allowing mutable registry code to execute without an installation prompt. That process can access SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY; compromised future releases could expose credentials or modify local files despite the documented read-only intent.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The examples explicitly select @latest and suppress installation confirmation with -y. This establishes a supply chain exposure, not evidence that the package is malicious.

content.value_statement: Creator research requires consistent post evidence across accounts and publishing periods. This skill guides SocialDataX retrieval and organizes available titles, timestamps, engagement signals, and comparison observations.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve creator post lists using an account ID, profile URL, short link, or profile share text.
Use documented CLI commands or available MCP tools for Xiaohongshu creator post retrieval.
Collect bounded page sets and merge results while preserving complete pagination tokens and note identifiers.
Organize available titles, descriptions, publishing times, engagement data, media links, and content types as research evidence.
Apply CLI date filtering or filter returned publishing timestamps during MCP-based analysis.
Preserve partial results and resume pagination within the original page and item limits.
limitations: Live retrieval requires a configured SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient service balance.
CLI use requires Node.js and npm; MCP use requires tools already available in the agent environment.
Returned fields and coverage depend on the provider; partial results do not prove complete account history.
The documented workflow does not log in, publish, like, comment, modify accounts, or provide an automatic monitoring schedule.

use_cases.title: Review Creator Partnership Fit
use_cases.description: Review a creator's recent post topics, formats, and available engagement signals before planning a brand partnership.

use_cases.title: Compare Managed Accounts
use_cases.description: Collect bounded post samples across selected accounts and compare publishing patterns with clear evidence and coverage limits.

use_cases.title: Plan Content Experiments
use_cases.description: Study relevant peer accounts and identify topic or format experiments without copying their posts.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Creator
prompt_templates.prompt: Research this Xiaohongshu profile: [profile URL]. Retrieve one page and summarize available titles, publishing times, and engagement signals. State any missing fields.

prompt_templates.title: Review Recent Publishing
prompt_templates.prompt: Research account [user ID] for the last [number] days. Collect at most [item limit] posts. Summarize topics and formats. Explain date filtering and coverage.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review a bounded publishing period.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Creator Samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [profile A] and [profile B] using at most two pages per account. Separate observed topics, formats, and engagement signals. Preserve full note identifiers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare accounts with consistent collection limits.

prompt_templates.title: Resume an Incomplete Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume this partial creator comparison: [saved results and pagination state]. Keep the original query and limits. Use valid continuation tokens. Report gaps without restarting completed pages.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: recover a research workflow without duplicating collection.

output_examples.input: Review one page from a selected creator profile and summarize the content.
output: Illustrative summary: The retrieved sample emphasizes product demonstrations and practical advice.
Evidence: Available titles, publishing times, engagement signals, and complete note identifiers accompany each observation.
Coverage: One page was reviewed. Earlier posts and missing fields were not inferred.

output_examples.input: Compare two creator samples when the second account returns incomplete results.
output: Illustrative comparison: Account A emphasizes tutorials; the available Account B sample emphasizes product reviews.
Coverage: Account B returned partial results, so engagement comparisons remain provisional.
Recovery: Preserve collected posts and continue only with a valid returned token and the remaining collection limits.

best_practices: Use a complete account ID or profile input, and set explicit page or item limits before retrieval.
Keep full note identifiers and continuation tokens unchanged; disclose partial coverage and missing data.
Review the external CLI package before execution, and keep API keys in environment configuration rather than prompts or reports.
anti_patterns: Requesting all pages without a collection budget or treating a partial response as complete account history.
Truncating continuation tokens, mixing tokens across accounts, or restarting completed pages after a partial failure.
Sharing API keys in chat or assuming a documented read-only workflow verifies an external package's behavior.

faq.question: Which account inputs are supported?
faq.answer: Use a Xiaohongshu account ID, profile URL, short link, or profile share text. Choose one input type per call.

faq.question: What do I need for live retrieval?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and sufficient service balance. Use Node.js and npm for CLI access, or existing compatible MCP tools.

faq.question: Does this skill change my Xiaohongshu account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only and excludes login, publishing, likes, comments, and account changes. The external CLI implementation was not audited here.

faq.question: Can I limit research to recent posts?
faq.answer: The CLI documents --since-days filtering. With MCP, retrieve the needed pages and filter returned publish_time values during analysis.

faq.question: How should incomplete results be handled?
faq.answer: Preserve collected posts and errors. Resume with a valid continuation token and remaining limits. Do not automatically restart from the first page.

faq.question: What happens when my balance is insufficient?
faq.answer: Stop repeated retries and use the provider billing page. After funding the correct account, resume according to the existing pagination state.
